```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, comment = "#>")
```

## Install and load

```{r}
remotes::install_github("vigliafg/rstats-commander",
                        subdir = "plugins/RcmdrShinyPlugin.survival")
RcmdrShiny::run(plugins = "RcmdrShinyPlugin.survival")
```

The plugin adds a **Survival** menu that wraps the `survival` package.

## Data shape

Survival data need one row per subject with at least:

- a follow-up time;
- an event indicator (1 = event, 0 = censored);
- optionally, grouping and explanatory variables.

```{r}
head(lung)
```

## Kaplan-Meier estimate

**Survival > Kaplan-Meier...** builds:

```{r}
.fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = lung)
plot(.fit, col = 1:2, lwd = 2, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival")
summary(.fit)
```

The plot appears in the **Plots** tab.  The summary shows the estimated survival
at each event time, with confidence limits.

## Log-rank test

**Survival > Log-rank test...** compares curves:

```{r}
survival::survdiff(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = lung)
```

A small p-value says that at least two curves differ; it does not quantify the
size of the difference.

## Cox proportional hazards

**Survival > Cox model...** fits:

```{r}
.cox <- survival::coxph(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = lung)
summary(.cox)
```

`exp(coef)` is the hazard ratio.  The proportional-hazards assumption is checked
with:

```{r}
survival::cox.zph(.cox)
```

A significant test for a predictor, or a trend in the Schoenfeld residuals,
suggests that its effect changes over time.

## Parametric models

**Survival > Parametric survival...** wraps `survreg()` with exponential,
Weibull, log-normal and other distributions.

## Reporting

The plugin writes the same commands you would write by hand, so the analysis can
move to a script unchanged.  Combine the Kaplan-Meier plot and the Cox table in
an R Markdown report.

## See also

The in-app **Help** tab lists the plugin topics under **Plugins**, and
`topic:plugins` explains how plugins are loaded.
